sections.title: Complete Case Study 4 traceability matrix
sections.result: Original Case Study 4 PDF pages 16–19 audited across 104 rows below, including objectives, scope, all capabilities, the seven workflow steps, inputs/outputs, stakeholders, individual technology choices, benefits/metrics, risks and staged governance. sections.title: RAG verification
sections.result: Deployed authorized target/related source and guidance retrieved with snapshot provenance; 68 source blocks and 43 source quotes match original files. Similarity is not a dependency proof. All 31 original function signature/line boundaries and seven full captured files matched. Baseline exact plus vector retrieval; authorization/path/snapshot filtering inspected and regression-tested. Context includes original demo guidance. Required target inclusion and explicit limitations retained; related vectors do not resolve ownership, dispatch or whole-program dependencies.

sections.title: Cppcheck verification
sections.result: Cppcheck 2.10 ran in deployment with valid mapped evidence; missing system includes/default language configuration leave coverage degraded. Native audit also ran Cppcheck 2.22.0 earlier on disposable captured source; do not conflate versions. Container 2.10 was used in current review. shell=False, configured deterministic executable, 30-second timeout and 1 MiB output bound. Analyzer failure is not zero findings. No source build, script, hook or log-embedded command executed.

sections.title: Local/private architecture verification
sections.result: Local Qwen/Ollama, pinned offline CPU Jina and local Chroma/PostgreSQL verified; source/model mounts read-only. This is local architecture verification, not a packet-capture or production security certification. Ollama digest dae161e27b0e90dd1856c8bb3209201fd6736d8eb66298e75ed87571486f4364; Jina revision 516f4baf13dec4ddddda8631e019b5737c8bc250/code 3baf9e3ac750e76e8edd3019170176884695fb94, CPU/offline 768 dimensions. Optional optimum/ONNX warning did not prevent ordinary embedding. UI/API bind loopback, PostgreSQL not exposed. No enterprise IAM/encryption or packet-level acceptance claim. Captured final 500-line service log tails contained neither the configured credential nor the checked representative source-return statement; this bounded check is not a proof of all historical logs or network traffic. Temporary report viewer was stopped; all three deployed services remained healthy.

sections.title: MISRA notice verification
sections.result: Exact notice preserved in UI/HTML: This review demonstrates MISRA-oriented and internal coding-standard assistance. Formal MISRA compliance requires approved/licensed standards, qualified tools, and engineering review. Only original/demo rules used. No actual MISRA text downloaded, copied, embedded or reproduced. No compliance claim. Licensed/approved guidance remains a future capability.

sections.title: C/C++ scope
sections.result: Six authorized extensions, both grammars and parser regressions; original C++ function boundaries verified. No OOP/whole-program analysis claim. V1 does not establish OOP dispatch, whole-program data flow, build-aware compiler semantics or additional languages. Ordinary directories and Git working trees supported through content snapshots; Git optional read-only metadata only.

sections.title: Source-of-truth comparison
sections.result: Independent current checks: 64 protected file hashes unchanged; all pre-existing PostgreSQL rows retain hashes. Counts before: 226 analysis runs, 110 findings, zero reviews, five repository runs; after: 278/135/3/6. Across 52 new runs, 68 original source blocks and 43 source citation quotes matched (only terminal-newline representation normalized for block comparison). All seven file previews and 31 parsed boundaries matched original source. Both actual JSON downloads match API and stored bodies. Citation/source validity does not certify diagnosis or imported-log authenticity.

sections.title: Product defects found and fixed
sections.result: Three genuine UI defects fixed surgically: (1) evidence 409 errors misleadingly described reviewer history conflicts; general conflict message now preserves precise expandable detail; (2) duplicate finding option labels could change selection on rerun, fixed with Result N; (3) same-minute history labels ambiguous, fixed with Review N/Run N. Failure reproductions retained and targeted tests pass. Changed production files only ui/components.py and ui/streamlit_app.py; tests/test_polish.py updated. Docker transient directory repair was separately explicitly authorized; backups retained.

sections.title: Model-quality failures observed but NOT tuned
sections.result: No tuning, prompt changes, model promotion or label/source changes. Original Checkpoint 2 fixed-corpus 16 TP/4 FN/1 FP, 94.12% precision/80% recall preserved: calculatePressure/readActivePressure/activateSession/doubleFreeSample misses and readSensor FP. Current separate run has additional useFreedSample wrong-category miss: 15 TP/5 FN/1 FP. Prior AST/guard experiment artifacts remain unchanged and baseline deployed. Original doubleFreeSample corrective-retry/context-budget failure was investigated in docs/checkpoint3-progress.md; a later completed wrong-category finding does not erase that failure. New Q&A/explanation weaknesses, weak security fix and scanf overstatement remain recorded.

sections.title: Complete regression results
sections.result: All 151 unittest regressions passed in 30.019 seconds after the three UI fixes; targeted 19 polish tests passed in 3.911 seconds. New tests reproduce evidence-conflict wording, duplicate finding labels/rerun selection and duplicate same-minute history labels. Earlier failure reproductions retained. Disposable tests cover authorization/path escapes, stale/deleted snapshots, overloads/pagination, dependencies, context/citation validation, imports, history and HTML escaping. Mocked tests and live model semantics are reported separately; no claim that passing unit tests improves accuracy.

sections.title: Screenshots
sections.result: Actual screenshots listed below: deployed Overview/progress/completion/source/Q&A/finding/history/diagnostic/printable desktop and six narrow page views plus editor. Older clean/API-down screenshots explicitly demonstrate native failure path. Images exist as PNG; no mockups. Private DOM and full reports retain exact interactions.

sections.title: Remaining limitations
sections.result: Overall PARTIAL acceptance, no universal-accuracy or complete sign-off claim. Workflow/runtime repairs complete and data preserved, but model misses/false positive/wrong categories and explanation contradictions remain. Static analysis degraded; XML interpretation and structured diagnostic remediation incomplete. Imported origin unverified. No physical print pagination, two-browser live conflict, production isolation/encryption or productivity/defect-leakage measurement. Current corpus has no actual overload/large-page fixture; those checks are disposable regressions. Bounded pilot history and context remain intentional.

sections.title: Readiness for future 200-function unseen evaluation
sections.result: Current harness is fixed to demo_ecu/30 labeled functions; separate-corpus configuration, full per-category metrics and granular failure taxonomy are incomplete. No new holdout was created. Audit only: no new scorer, labels, holdout, verifier, analyzer pattern or architecture added. The application can index another explicitly authorized C/C++ directory, which does not by itself make a reproducible 200-case unseen benchmark.
